newsitem.title: USA: Richardson Electronics to buy Burtek.
newsitem.headline: Richardson Electronics to buy Burtek.

text.p: Richardson Electronics Ltd said it signed an agreement to buy Burtek Systems Inc, a Canadian distributor of security systems.
Terms of deal were not disclosed.
In a release dated March 11, Richardson said Burtek, with headquarters in Vancouver, has annual sales of about $18 million.
Richardson said its security division grew 86 percent to $25.6 million in fiscal 1996. Richardson said it will continue to operate in Canada under the Burtek name.
The agreement is subject to completion of certain corporate formalities under Canadian law, the company said. The deal is expected to close within two weeks.
